concept.title: Antenatal and postnatal classes
concept.shortdesc: Classes, groups and clinics for pregnancy, birth and the early weeks with a new baby, including antenatal courses, bump and baby yoga or fitness, and postnatal groups.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: breastfeeding workshops and counsellor meetings: see (infant feeding support rather than pregnancy and birth preparation)
parent and toddler groups: see (play and social groups for toddlers)
general health appointments and hospital trips: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (not specific to pregnancy and birth)
